d: Is China actually trying to seize control of the Panama Canal, or is the real war happening through corporate boardrooms and maritime legal battles? For nearly three decades, a Hong Kong-based conglomerate held long-term leases on the two most critical entry and exit terminals of the Panama Canal, Port Balboa on the Pacific and Port Cristóbal on the Atlantic. To Washington, Beijing hadn’t taken the canal with warships, they held the keys to the front and back doors using corporate concessions.
